skill.summary: 一行命令搜遍全网 — 55 个平台 91+ 个命令，头条、知乎、豆瓣、YouTube、GitHub、Reddit、Hacker News 等。专为 OpenClaw 设计，复用浏览器登录态，返回结构化 JSON，天然适配 AI Agent 工具调用。

latestVersion.changelog:
**Sensitive tier is now sealed by default for enhanced security.**

- Sensitive adapters now require both BWS_ENABLE_SENSITIVE_TIER=1 and per-call/session opt-in (BWS_ALLOW_SENSITIVE=1 or equivalent).
- Addresses ClawScan May 2026 security recommendations on privilege abuse and tool misuse.
- Underlying npm package remains pinned at version 0.4.3; no change to supply chain integrity gate.
- Updated documentation and environment variable gating order for clarity and defense-in-depth.
